confirm a reservation: Please call the restaurant one day before to confirm your reservation, or they may give your table to other guests.
請在前一天打電話給餐廳確認訂位，否則他們可能會把你的桌位讓給其他客人。
confirm one's suspicions: The security camera video confirmed her suspicions that her roommate had been secretly eating her food.
監視器畫面證實了她的懷疑：室友一直在偷吃她的食物。
confirm the appointment: The Senate voted to confirm the appointment of the new judge after a long and heated debate.
參議院經過一場漫長而激烈的辯論後，投票確認了新法官的任命。
confirm the date: Before booking the flights, I emailed my cousin to confirm the date of her wedding.
訂機票之前，我寄電子郵件給表姊，確認她婚禮的日期。
conform to the rules: Every new product must conform to the safety rules before it can be sold in stores.
每項新產品在上架販售前，都必須遵守安全規定。
conform to standards: All the toys sold in this country must conform to strict standards to keep children safe.
在這個國家販售的所有玩具都必須符合嚴格的標準，以確保兒童安全。
pressure to conform: Many teenagers feel strong pressure to conform, so they wear the same clothes and like the same music as their friends.
許多青少年感受到強烈的從眾壓力，所以他們穿和朋友一樣的衣服、喜歡一樣的音樂。
confront the problem: Instead of hiding from it, we should confront the problem directly and talk about it honestly.
與其逃避，我們應該直接面對問題，坦誠地談一談。
confront one's fears: To confront her fears, Amy, who was terrified of heights, signed up for a rock-climbing class.
為了直面恐懼，非常怕高的Amy報名了攀岩課。
be confronted with a choice: After graduation, Jack was confronted with a difficult choice: take a job in Taipei or study abroad.
畢業後，Jack面臨一個艱難的抉擇：在台北工作還是出國留學。
confront a suspect: The detective decided to confront the suspect with the new evidence to see how he would react.
警探決定拿新證據與嫌犯對質，看看他會有什麼反應。
congratulate someone on: Everyone in the office came over to congratulate her on her promotion to manager.
辦公室裡的每個人都過來恭喜她升上經理。
congratulate oneself: He congratulated himself on bringing an umbrella when the heavy rain suddenly started on his way home.
回家路上突然下起大雨時，他暗自慶幸自己有帶傘。
conquer fear: Through years of practice, she conquered her fear of speaking in public and became a confident speaker.
經過多年練習，她克服了對公開演講的恐懼，成為一位自信的講者。
conquer the market: The small company hopes its cheap and stylish phones will conquer the Asian market within five years.
這家小公司希望它便宜又時尚的手機能在五年內征服亞洲市場。
conquer a disease: Thanks to vaccines, humans have conquered a disease that once killed millions of people every year.
多虧了疫苗，人類戰勝了一種曾經每年奪走數百萬人性命的疾病。
conquer a mountain: After three failed attempts, the climber finally conquered the mountain and planted a flag at the top.
失敗三次之後，那位登山者終於征服了這座高山，並在山頂插上旗子。
consent to surgery: Because the patient was only fifteen, his parents had to sign a form to consent to the surgery.
因為病人只有十五歲，他的父母必須簽表格同意手術。
give consent: Your parents must give consent before you can join the overnight school trip to Kenting.
你的父母必須給予同意，你才能參加墾丁的過夜校外教學。
without consent: You should never post photos of other people online without their consent.
未經他人同意，你絕不該把他們的照片貼到網路上。
consist of three parts: The English exam consists of three parts: listening, reading, and writing, and it takes two hours.
這場英文考試由三部分組成：聽力、閱讀和寫作，需時兩小時。
consist in hard work: My grandfather always said that true success consists in hard work, not in luck or money.
我爺爺總是說，真正的成功在於努力，而不在於運氣或金錢。
be consistent with: The witness's story is consistent with the security video, so the police believe she is telling the truth.
證人的說法與監視器影片一致，所以警方相信她說的是實話。
constitute a threat: Experts warn that rising sea levels constitute a serious threat to low-lying islands in the Pacific.
專家警告，海平面上升對太平洋的低窪島嶼構成嚴重威脅。
constitute a majority: Women now constitute a majority of the students at this medical school, which was rare fifty years ago.
女性現在占這所醫學院學生的多數，這在五十年前很少見。
constitute a crime: Sharing someone's private photos without permission may constitute a crime in many countries.
未經允許分享別人的私密照片，在許多國家可能構成犯罪。
women constitute half: Women constitute half of the population, yet they hold only a small number of seats in the government.
女性占人口的一半，卻只在政府中占有少數席次。
construct an argument: In this essay, you must construct a clear argument and support it with facts and examples.
在這篇論文中，你必須建構清楚的論點，並用事實和例子支持它。
construct a sentence: Can you construct a sentence using the word "although" to connect two different ideas?
你能用「although」這個字連接兩個不同的想法來造句嗎？
construct a theory: Einstein spent years constructing a theory that changed the way we understand time and space.
愛因斯坦花了好幾年建構一套理論，改變了我們理解時間與空間的方式。
construct a bridge: The government plans to construct a bridge across the river so villagers no longer need to take a boat.
政府計畫建一座橫跨河流的橋，讓村民不必再搭船。
